pattern: WAI-ARIA APG grid for every view except the agenda: table role=grid with day or slot gridcells under one roving tab stop; events are buttons inside the cell where they start (APG "cells containing widgets": Enter/F2 in, Escape/F2 out). The agenda is a region with day headings and lists under one roving tab stop. Moves have three equivalent paths (drag, Ctrl/Cmd+X then Ctrl/Cmd+V, toolbar Move / Move here).

aria.value: Date (and slot time, and resource), then "non-working time", holiday, and the number of events starting there
Title, time or dates, location, "repeats ..." for series, "read-only" in edit mode
"true" on cells of a keyboard or pointer selection
Total rows and the index of each rendered row

keyboard.action: Move between days or slots; past the edge of a day or week, the neighbouring period (month: the previous or next week row).
First / last cell of the row; with Ctrl/Cmd, the first / last cell of the grid.
Extend a selection (within one day in time views, one resource in the timeline).
Move to the first event of the cell (or "+N more"); on an empty cell or with a selection, emit aui-slot-activate.
Emit aui-slot-activate for the cell or selection.
Previous / next event of the same cell.
Move the event to that cell (time kept on day cells); Escape on a cell cancels.

keyboard.context: Timed event in day or week views (edit mode)
Bars in month, all-day row, timeline (edit mode)
keyboard.action: Lengthen / shorten by a day or a snap (mirrored in RTL).
Toolbar buttons, then the grid (one tab stop).

focus: One roving tab stop per view; changing the period moves it to the anchor date (at scrollToHour in time views). After an edit, focus follows the event (its key changes when an exception is created); after toolbar edits focus stays on the toolbar. The recurring-scope dialog restores focus on close.
notes: Event colors are never the only cue: titles, times, and names carry the meaning; non-working cells say so in their names.
Moves and resizes are announced ("Design review moved to 30 Sept 2026, 11:00 to 12:30.").
Pointer dragging has single-pointer alternatives (toolbar Move / Move here / Shorten / Lengthen), WCAG 2.5.7.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
Very long cell names in dense weeks are read in full; the count of events keeps them short.
